verdict.rationale: Productboard's REST API (v2) lets users read/search/create feedback, customers, and product hierarchy data programmatically, which could be used to script a full data export, but there is no documented bulk-export feature, no stated open-format (CSV/JSON) export guarantee, and no explicit 'leave with your data' or account-export tool. missing for 10: dedicated bulk/full-account export feature, explicit open-format export documentation, and any evidence of data portability guarantees beyond ad-hoc API calls.
